topics.name: streaks and gamification
topics.description: Streaks, badges, leagues, XP, gems, quests and reminders, and whether they motivate learners or feel manipulative and pressuring.

topics.name: lesson design and learning effectiveness
topics.description: Lesson length, format, pacing, repetition, exercise variety, curriculum flow and whether the material sticks or feels padded.

topics.name: speaking and pronunciation feedback
topics.description: Accuracy and usefulness of mic scoring, speech recognition, accent coaching and pronunciation feedback, including noise and accent problems.

topics.name: conversation bot practice
topics.description: Experience with the chat or practice bot: realism, scenarios, memory, error correction, voice support and repetitiveness.

topics.name: language and course availability
topics.description: Range of languages offered, depth of individual courses, dialect options and uneven content across courses or source languages.

topics.name: live tutor sessions
topics.description: Quality, availability, booking, cancellation and reliability of live human tutors and their video sessions.

topics.name: grammar teaching and explanations
topics.description: How well grammar rules, tables, notes and explanations are provided, their clarity, and gaps in grammar coverage.

topics.name: offline mode and device sync
topics.description: Offline downloads, progress syncing across devices, app compatibility, installation and technical glitches.

topics.name: progress tracking and placement
topics.description: Placement tests, level estimates, skill charts, dashboards, reports and the accuracy and usefulness of progress measurements.

method.providerLabel: Two-phase topics (Anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5 (topic-discovery-v2) → consolidation (topic-consolidation-v3) + TypeSafe jev-latest (jev-topic-a1), batches of ≤ 25)
